description: Phase 4.1 gate. Each question runs through the full pipeline (route -> retrieve -> merge) then synthesize. Pass = non-empty answer that is not the no-answer sentinel, at least one citation, every citation.chunk_id non-empty AND in the retrieved set, and every string in must_mention present in the answer (case-insensitive). Questions span the VECTOR / GRAPH-neighbors / GRAPH-count / GRAPH-blast-radius / GRAPH-two-hop shapes.
